purpose: Build a fail-closed exact-universe manifest and restartable checkpoints before any full OpenDART corporate-action collection

traversal.query_start_rule: query_start equals earliest listed_date in the exact selected base universe
traversal.additional_page_rule: every page 2 through total_page returned by each first-page request
traversal.document_rule: every accepted unique rcept_no has one PASS original document package; an exact HTTP 200 OpenDART 014 response may be terminal UNAVAILABLE for traversal but never satisfies full capture
traversal.order: stock_code ascending, series contract order, page ascending, rcept_no ascending

checkpoint_contract.idempotent_replay: identical latest PASS, FAIL, or UNAVAILABLE attempt is a no-op
checkpoint_contract.document_unavailable_rule: UNAVAILABLE requires package_member_count 0 and error_code DART_DOCUMENT_STATUS_014 backed by an immutable hashed raw XML response journal
checkpoint_contract.document_unavailable_effect: checkpoint the receipt, continue with the next request in the same run, and skip it on replay while keeping full_capture_complete false and all downstream publication blocked
checkpoint_contract.list_success_rule: dart_status 013 requires first page, total_page 0, row_count 0, and no receipts; dart_status 000 requires total_page at least 1

request_budget.daily_limit_note: OpenDART documents status 020 as generally occurring above 20000 requests, but the effective limit may differ; this is advisory and never an execution authorization

publication_rule: manifest, checkpoint, and diagnostic status only; never publish acquisition evidence, adapter components, canonical, M2, candidates, targets, or orders
